tone.title: Mesa 90s Dual Rectifier RI - Red Modern FULL RIG
tone.description:
A full rig (amp+cab) capture of the Red channel in Modern mode, set to Bold power and diode rectification. One models boosted with a Maxon OD808 and one without from a completely stock 2024 Mesa/Boogie 90s Dual Rectifier Reissue captured through a 4x12 v30s blended SM57 and e609 microphone setup.

This is the immediate, unapologetic Rectifier voice: tight low end, aggressive upper mids, saturated gain, and plenty of weight for modern metal, hard rock, punk, and everything in between. Load your preferred cab IR after NAM and make it your own.

This is one curated capture from the Mad Hatter 90s Dual Rectifier Resissue collection. The complete pack includes Red and Orange channels, Vintage and Modern voicings, plus both DI captures for your own IR workflow and full-rig captures for immediate use.

The complete collection includes 68 calibrate NAM A2 profiles: 34 DI captures and matching full-rig versions. It covers Orange Clean, Orange Vintage, Orange Modern, Red Vintage, and Red Modern, with Bold and Spongy power settings plus tube and diode rectification options.

Reamp chain: 
Motu M4 > Lehle P-Split III > Maxon OD808 > Mesa 90s Dual Rectifier > V30 > SM57/e609 mic blend > Motu M4

Amp Specs:
Power Tubes: Stock Mesa 6L6 445 RED
Preamp Tubes: Stock Mesa 12AX7

Full pack: https://shop.madhatteramplab.com/s/mesa-90s-dual-rec-t3k
